channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: In Hanoi’s Trang Cat Village, ‘dong’ leaf harvest marks start of Tet season
item.description: As the 2025 Lunar Year draws to a close and winter air settles over northern Vietnam, Trang Cat Village on the banks of the Day River in Hanoi turns a deep, luminous green, marking the start of its busiest season.

item.title: Vietnam wins 1st Asian shooting gold of 2026
item.description: Vietnam won its first Asian shooting gold medal of 2026 on Monday when Nguyen Thuy Trang claimed the women’s 25-meter sport pistol title at the Asian Rifle and Pistol Championships in India.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City traffic police step up efforts to restore order at wholesale markets ahead of Tet
item.description: Traffic police in Ho Chi Minh City are intensifying coordination with relevant forces to restore urban order and ensure traffic safety at wholesale markets as the Lunar New Year holiday, or Tet, approaches, amid increasingly complex traffic conditions.

item.title: 'I need to improve', says Haaland after barren spell
item.description: MANCHESTER, United Kingdom -- Erling Haaland said tiredness was no excuse for his poor goalscoring run in 2026 as he demands more of himself to keep Manchester City in the hunt for four trophies.

item.title: Japan restarts world's biggest nuclear plant again
item.description: Japan switched on the world's biggest nuclear power plant again on Monday, its operator said, after an earlier attempt was quickly suspended due to a minor glitch.

item.title: India says it will maintain multiple sources of energy supply
item.description: NEW DELHI - India plans to maintain multiple sources of energy supply and diversify them when needed as New Delhi looks to ensure consumers receive "adequate energy at the right price through reliable and secure supplies", Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri said on Monday.

item.title: AI no better than other methods for patients seeking medical advice, study shows
item.description: LONDON - Asking AI about medical symptoms does not help patients make better decisions about their health than other methods, such as a standard internet search, according to a new study published in Nature Medicine.

item.title: Vietnam ministry proposes meals for passengers on flights delayed 2 hours or more
item.description: The Ministry of Construction has proposed new regulations requiring airlines to provide meals and drinks to passengers when flights are delayed by two hours or more, and to fully refund tickets for delays of three hours or longer.

item.title: Hoi An launches smart ticketing system with multilingual guides
item.description: Hoi An has introduced 12 automated ticketing kiosks, offering multilingual support and smart tourism solutions to enhance visitor experiences and accelerate digital transformation in Vietnam’s UNESCO-listed ancient town.

item.title: Vietnam PM hosts Tet banquet for diplomatic corps
item.description: Vietnam reaffirmed its appreciation for the continued support of international partners and called for stronger cooperation, dialogue, and mutual trust, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh said while hosting a Tet banquet for ambassadors and heads of international organizations in Hanoi on Monday evening.
